competitions.name: Asian Para Games 2026, Aichi-Nagoya
competitions.note: 5th Asian Para Games, Aichi-Nagoya (18–24 Oct). India's medals on 19 Oct: Mona Agarwal won women's 10m air rifle SH1 gold with a Games record 250.0 (Avani Lekhara silver); Nishad Kumar won men's long jump T47 gold with 7.11m (high jump T47 final on 20 Oct); Kokila won women's J2 -52kg judo silver after beating world champion Liu Yi (China) in the semi-final, losing the final by ippon in 21 seconds to Kyrgyzstan's Aibike Ulanbek Kyzy; judoka Kapil Parmar won men's J1 -70kg bronze. Sonalben Patel (women's singles C3) and Prachi Pandey (Class 6) are assured of para table tennis medals (semi-finals 20 Oct); Nitesh Kumar/Thulasimathi Murugesan are assured of a para badminton mixed doubles medal; powerlifter Jaspreet Kaur finished fourth in the women's 45kg; Sheetal Devi equalled the compound ranking-round world record (704/720). Also on 19 Oct: Rinku Hooda won men's javelin F46 gold (65.11m) with Ajeet Singh Yadav silver (65.02m); Ravi Karthik Budigina won men's 100m freestyle S13 silver. Broadcast details for India not confirmed. Update 19:20 IST: India 11 medals (4 gold, 5 silver, 2 bronze), fourth behind China, Japan, Uzbekistan; in the women's 1500m, Soumya won T12/T13 gold with Radha Venkatesh silver, and Ravanni Valasanaini took T11 bronze. India's para coach expects about six medals on 20 Oct; Sony Sports Ten 2/3, DD Sports (free) and SonyLIV carry the Games.
